h201.text: This is Momo. This is a teddy bear. Two eyes. Soft fur. One is living. One is not.

h202.text: Easy? Then try the six things in our box.

h203.text: First, a practice round. The teddy bear. Point left for living. Point right for non-living. Go!

m207.text: But it has eyes and fur like me. Why isn't it living?

h208.text: The teddy bear is a non-living thing. Eyes and fur are only how it looks. We need better clues.

h301.text: Here is the game. It's You against the Buddies. You lock in first. Then Pip, Basil and Momo answer.

h302.text: Every time you are right, put up one finger on your other hand. No lock-in, no point. And a lizard is hiding in this video. Find it!

h401.text: Our six things came from here. A void deck and a garden in Toa Payoh. Look around.

h402.text: A mynah. Ants. A papaya tree. A bench. A bicycle. A blue recycling bin. So many different things!

h403.text: There is a great variety of living and non-living things around us. This is called diversity.

b404.text: So many! How do we keep track?

h405.text: Let's start off with six. Let's put them into our glass box, and bring them back.

h501.text: Are you ready? Three! Two! One! Go!

h502.text: Day one. Six things, one box. The lid has holes, so air can get in. The mealworm has oats to eat, and a juicy carrot for water. The plant has moist soil, and sunlight from the window.

h601.text: Round one. The wind-up robot. Look at it go! Point left for living. Point right for non-living.

b603.text: Living! It moves, so it's living!

p604.text: Non-living. I saw you wind it up, Basil.

m605.text: Non-living. Does it ever get hungry?

h606.text: Watch. The robot stops. A spring inside was pushing it.

h606b.text: Nobody winds it up, so it stays still. All night. All of day two.

h607.text: It does not need water, food or air. It does not grow. The wind-up robot is a non-living thing.

b609.text: Aww. So moving is not the clue!

m610.text: Then is a thing that stays still always non-living?

h701.text: Round two. Day two. The green bean. It is a seed. It has not moved at all. Living, or non-living? Point!

p703.text: Non-living. I watched it for one whole day. It did nothing.

m704.text: Living! It's green, like a leaf.

b705.text: Living! Bean sprouts grow from green beans. I eat bean sprouts!

h706.text: Three buddies, two answers. Let's shrink down and watch. Quietly.

h707.text: You are tiny now. The green bean is as big as a bus.

h709.text: The skin splits. A root pushes out.

h710.text: Nobody wound it up. Nobody pushed it. It is growing by itself.

h711.text: The green bean is a living thing. It was living all along. It took in water. Then it began to grow.

p713.text: I was careful. But I did not watch long enough.

h714.text: Momo, living is right. But green is only how it looks. A green pencil is non-living.

m715.text: No point for me! So what ARE the clues?

h845.text: Did you spot the lizard? It was on the window at night, on day one. Is a lizard living or non-living? Tell someone at home.

h850.text: Our box has twenty-five more days to go. What will be under the cloth on Day thirty? Find out in Part Two!

h860.text: Let's read today's key words together! Ready?
